source_caption:
🎬 The Legend of Tarzan (2016)

The Legend of Tarzan follows John Clayton, a man once known as Tarzan who has left his wild life in the African jungle behind to live as a wealthy English nobleman with his wife, Jane. Years after returning to civilization, he is invited back to the Congo, unaware that the journey is part of a dangerous plot orchestrated by a ruthless Belgian official. When Jane is kidnapped and the people of the Congo face a growing threat, Tarzan must reconnect with his past and embrace the extraordinary abilities that once made him king of the jungle. With the help of his allies and the animals he once lived among, he sets out on a dangerous mission to save those he loves. Starring Alexander Skarsgård, Margot Robbie, Samuel L. Jackson, and Christoph Waltz, the film combines breathtaking adventure, thrilling action, romance, and a story about courage, identity, and protecting family.

🎭 Genre: Action • Adventure • Fantasy • Romance

⭐ IMDb: 6.2/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 50m • PG-13

🎥 Director: David Yates

✍️ Writers: Adam Cozad & Craig Brewer

📚 Based On: The Tarzan character created by Edgar Rice Burroughs.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV for current streaming or rental availability in the United States.

source_details.title: The Legend of Tarzan
source_details.synopsis: The Legend of Tarzan is a 2016 action adventure film directed by David Yates. Based on the character Tarzan created by Edgar Rice Burroughs, the film features an ensemble cast including Alexander Skarsgård, Samuel L. Jackson, Margot Robbie, Djimon Hounsou, and Christoph Waltz. The story follows John Clayton (Tarzan), who, after moving to London, is convinced by George Washington Williams to return to his former home in the jungles of Africa, to investigate claims of slavery. Principal photography began on June 21, 2014, at Leavesden Studios in the United Kingdom and wrapped four months later.
